selection: First unique non-pinned, previously unscreened topics in captured page and row order; no keyword or checker filter.
listing_failures: Retain each requested page, including unavailable or malformed responses. Continue the bounded page list without replacement.
capture_failures: Retain every selected topic outcome. Do not replace a failed capture with another topic.
exposure: Development discovery cohort. Existing source exposure and API-shape inspection are not blinded; no held-out claim.
labels: All captured topics await screening. Code blocks, attachment counts, and accepted-answer flags do not establish a defect, correction, or gold label.
budget: Time the first listing request and the first selected complete-thread capture before estimating remaining work. Serial requests, 30-second timeout and 16-MiB limit per response, inherited from the source collector. No simulations or checker invocations.
